copy.headline: Cooper Flagg leads Mavericks' rally to beat Suns, finish 4-0 in NBA Cup group play
copy.caption: Cooper Flagg scored 34 points and led a late Dallas charge in a 113-109 victory over the Phoenix Suns that left the Mavericks perfect in NBA Cup group play.
